<thought>We need to list the molecular fragments that can be joined, providing their SMILES. The best way to obtain the fragments is to use the `return_possible_fragments` tool, which will give us a list of fragment SMILES derived from the molecule described (C12H16O2). Once we have that list, we can output it in the required format.</thought>
<action>return_possible_fragments</action>
<action_input>{}</action_input>
